PROPERTY & PEDESTRIAN LIFE DEFENSE

COCONUT SAFETY NETS

Heavy-gauge canopy nets suspended beneath coconut palms to safely catch falling coconuts and fronds.

Direct Starting Rate: ₹26 / sq.ft
Durability Warranty: 3 to 5 Years UV Stable

A falling coconut weighing 2 to 4 kg descending from a 30-foot tree generates sufficient kinetic energy to shatter vehicle windshields, dent roof hoods, or cause fatal cranial trauma to pedestrians. InvisProtect Coconut Safety Nets are engineered with heavy-ply knotted nylon and HDPE braids slung under the canopy crown, deflecting and cradling falling nuts before they reach ground level.

Safety Is Not A Marketing Slogan

Every InvisProtect installation is backed by physical laboratory metallurgical certification, calibrated mechanical tensioning, and strict work-at-height engineering standards.

Virgin SS316 Marine Grade
